rules: Natural-state morphogenic liquid and assumed solid forms are distinct visual states of the same persistent entity.
A humanoid Founder-style form is a chosen form, not proof that every Changeling has one immutable humanoid face.
Copied appearance may reproduce visible surface form when World State says the transformation succeeded; it does not copy identity, memory, authorization or relationships.
Persistent identity must track the Changeling entity through form changes rather than treating every form as a new person.
allowed_variation: partial transformation only when authoritative state supports it
forbidden_variation: copied face treated as copied identity
visual form change granting clearance or knowledge
notes: For entity-backed assets, store habitual-form anchors separately from current_form state.
